ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: Within the time interval of 0~20 s, the magnitude of the particle's average velocity is 0.8 m/s
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a graph of the particle displacement x changing with time t, the horizontal axis is labeled t/s, and the vertical axis is labeled x/m. The grid shows that within the range from 0 to 20 s, the vertical coordinate of the curve at t=0 s is approximately x=0 m, and the vertical coordinate at t=20 s is approximately x=16 m. Then reason: The magnitude of the average velocity within 0~20 s is equal to the absolute value of the displacement change divided by the time interval, namely |v_average|=|x(20)-x(0)|/20=|16-0|/20=0.8 m/s.
